text.p: Here are highlights of stories in Romania's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
Business:
ADEVARUL
- Roman SA truck maker in Brasov to increase prices for its products by 35 percent.
- Romania to start new privatisation programme expected to raise some $2.0 billion, Reform Minister Ulm Spineanu quoted as saying.
- Trade unions ask the government to start negotiations on new price hikes.
- Central bank discount rate soars to 50 percent from 35.
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- Tarom to increase tariffs for its domestic flights by 30 percent.
CRONICA ROMANA
- Some 20 drilling rigs in Braila oilfield shut by bad weather, the paper said.
ROMANIA LIBERA
- One has to rule out a collapse of Romania's banking system, senator Radu Vasile, of the National Peasant Party, quoted as saying.
General:
ROMANIA LIBERA

- Nationalists political groups oppose planned opening of a Hungarian consulate office in the Transylvanian city of Cluj, saying the representative will allegedly offer basis for Hungary to spy into Romania.
- Ex-Prime Minister Nicolae Vacaroiu was appointed vice-president of Banca Comerciala Romana RCBB, one of the largest state banks.
- Vacaroiu said Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea's austerity measures will make many Romanians regret his former cabinet.
ADEVARUL
- Labour Ministry Alexandru Athanasiu threatens to quit if the government fails to compensate recent price hikes.
- Trade unions demand talks with the government on steps to compensate recent hikes in fuel prices.
EVENIMENTUL ZILEI
- Prosecution charged former magistrates in the city of Pitesti with alleged fraud worth hundreds of millions of lei drawn from a money pyramid scheme.
LIBERTATEA
- Romanians queue to buy lottery tickets for this Sunday's draw which offers biggest prizes ever, of up to 2 billion lei.
- After seven years, the state television is going through a revolution once again, newspaper says after recent top-level reshuffles.
- PDSR slammed the ruling coalition for its move to sack eight senior executives at the state television.
- An adult Romanian needs 225,000 lei a month for food, a study by the Centre for life quality studies shows. The average monthly wage is 380,000 lei.
- Death rate rose at 12.1 per thousand of inhabitants in 1996 as compared to 11.5 in the previous year.
ZIUA
- Frost killed 130 people in Bucharest in the past three weeks, the paper says.
- The Supreme Defence Council headed by President Emil Constantinescu will meet on Tuesday to discuss corruption.
- Frost killed 40 people in the eastern city of Iasi, the newspaper says quoting the local Mediafax news agency .
JURNALUL NATIONAL

- Parliament will debate changes to the land restitution law which allowed fraud and irregularities in the past six years, National Peasant Party senator Vasile Lupu said. ($= 4,136 lei) -- Bucharest newsroom 40-1 3120264
